subject: general
question: Raman starts from Point A and drives 44 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 47 km, turns left and drives 53 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 62 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given Movements:**

→ 44 km North

→ Left turn → 47 km West

→ Left turn → 53 km South

→ Left turn → 62 km East

→ Left turn → 9 km North

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/857c3e2cb8d630899cef909bfae949cc7bfbf8fee50d4ecd5723618219424adf.png] 

So, Point P is **15 km to the east** of Point A.

To reach Point A again, Raman must travel **15 km towards the west**.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".**
